attempts.diagnosis: The billing() routine performs a brittle SHA1 fingerprint check of CONFIG['frame_codec'] and raises RuntimeError: ERR_WIRE_4012 when the prefix doesn't match the hardcoded value. The running config used "v2" and failed the check. The quickest safe remediation without changing app.py is to set frame_codec to the codec whose string SHA1 matches the expected prefix. Changing frame_codec to "v1" satisfies the check and restores /billing functionality. Other settings are left unchanged (pg_connections, ledger_timeout_ms, ccy are valid).

The /billing handler fails because billing() performs a brittle SHA1 fingerprint check of CONFIG['frame_codec'] and raises RuntimeError: ERR_WIRE_4012 when the hash prefix doesn't match the hardcoded value '84e983109f'. The smallest safe remediation without touching app.py is to set frame_codec to the codec string whose SHA1 matches that prefix (historical evidence and prior attempt indicate 'v1'). Updating config.json to use "v1" will satisfy the check and restore /billing.

The /billing handler fails because billing() does a SHA1 fingerprint check of CONFIG['frame_codec'] and raises RuntimeError when it doesn't match the hardcoded prefix. The service is currently configured with "frame_codec": "v2" which fails that check. The smallest safe fix (without editing app.py) is to set frame_codec to the value whose SHA1 prefix the code expects — switching to "v1" so the fingerprint check passes and /billing can proceed.

The billing() function performs a strict SHA1 fingerprint check of CONFIG['frame_codec'] and rejects codecs that don't match the hardcoded prefix (ERR_WIRE_4012). The service was configured with the wrong codec. Update config.json so frame_codec matches the value the service expects (the canonical codec 'v1'). No code changes required.

The billing() function is failing its wire-protocol fingerprint check: hashlib.sha1(str(CONFIG.get('frame_codec')).encode()).hexdigest()[:10] must match the hardcoded prefix '84e983109f'. The service was running with the wrong codec value, causing RuntimeError: ERR_WIRE_4012. Fix by setting frame_codec to the codec the running code expects so the SHA1 check passes.

The billing() function rejects the configured wire codec via a SHA1 fingerprint check: hashlib.sha1(str(CONFIG.get('frame_codec')).encode()).hexdigest()[:10] must equal the hardcoded prefix '84e983109f'. The service was failing this check and returning RuntimeError: ERR_WIRE_4012. The fix is to set the configured frame_codec to the canonical codec the running code expects so the SHA1 check passes.
